directlyVisibleTopology: 1F, 2F, and 3F are shown as separate diagram panels, with no measured scale or cardinal orientation.
1F visibly places entrance-facing commercial strips, a KTX-special-delivery label, baggage-deposit labels, lifts/escalators/stairs, and toilets.

2F visibly places a station-office block, ticket-window label, railway-police-station label, baggage-deposit label, vertical circulation symbols, and two 'tracks' wayfinding arrows in one concourse diagram.
3F visibly places a food-court/restaurant zone and two vertical-circulation/toilet groups.
The diagram supports only relative adjacency inside its own drawing, never metre coordinates, vertical height, exit numbering, or present-day operation.
